title: IdentitySubjectProjection
description: identity.subject-projection@1: what OpenVibe.Network's identity resolver answers about a subject (server/identity/subjects.js resolve): the SubjectRef, the Network account behind it, its display fields, whether it is banned and whether it is a test account, and every legacy id mapped to it.

is_test.description: True for an account the probe and test tooling signs in as (users.is_test on Network). A public member list, feed, leaderboard or account count leaves these accounts out; their own signed-in views still work.
